resources.intent: Permit a genuine QR7 future-entry receipt with done1/sent0 at first case evaluation after an authored helper hold; preserve all old historical guards, timers, nodes and registration identities.
resources.scope: Only the original first evaluation of each unchanged admission-node identity, seeing a genuine QR7 future-entry receipt plus native sent0. Root issuance/admission/edges unchanged; no restarted helper or reopened skipped branch. A saved owner still waiting before gate evaluation can use this path; an already-processed branch is not revisited. No enrollment/contact repair, timer adoption, reset or synthetic ACK.
limits: Source partial order establishes an authored independent completion/loading boundary; actual latency and save scheduler behavior are LIVE_ONLY. No measured duplicate/missed-message occurrence is claimed.
An existing saved owner before first case evaluation is not force-reentered; applicability of changed resource predicates on specific saved handlers still needs an authorized transition fixture.
No old timer adoption/reset, synthetic ACK, native enrollment rewrite, actor/trigger availability claim or all-history support.
Coordinator must integrate alone into a fresh successor, serialize/read back final affected package and run preservation/package/compile gates.
